items.text: Where N-Dubz members are now from 'billionaire boyfriend to cryptic feud'
items.article: As N-Dubz announce plans for a 2027 UK arena tour, the Mirror takes a look at what Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer are up to nowadays, including a mysterious row that unfolded earlier this year Mere months after N-Dubz fans feared they'd never see the trio on stage together again, a UK reunion tour has been announced for 2027. Tula 'Tulisa' Contostavlos , Costadinos 'Dappy' Contostavlos and Richard 'Fazer' Rawson will be setting out on their eagerly awaited The Legacy Tour across February and March, with eight arena dates in the diary. It's unclear whether the Camden-bred group will be announcing any additional dates, but longtime fans will now doubt have their booking fingers at the ready when p re-sale tickets go on sale from 10 am Wednesday, October 7. N-Dubz made their mark on British music with their distinct hip-hop sound and use of slang, making hit after hit. After a 11-year hiatus, during which they pursued solo paths, N-Dubz re-formed in May 2022, with their single Charmer followed by a sold-out tour. It seemed as though the group was riding high once more, but behind the scenes, things weren't so rosy. Dappy later claimed he hadn't been paid for the UK arena tour, pledging never to perform with N-Dubz again. It would appear he has now put his grievances aside, but you can safely bet there may be more drama to come. Here, the Mirror takes a look at the rollercoaster lives of Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer, which have proven eventful whether together or apart...

items.article: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's ex-fiance Ken Urker’s sister, Autumn, recalled his last words to her before his death as she broke down on TikTok Live The sister of Gypsy Rose Blanchard ‘s late ex-fiancé Ken Urker shared the touching last words her brother said to her before his death . Shortly after news broke that Ken had been found dead on his 34th birthday on Thursday, October 1, Autumn Urker went live on her TikTok account . Autumn was visibly emotional throughout the livestream, breaking down and sobbing uncontrollably. Reflecting on their final conversation, she told her followers that Ken’s last words to her were, “I love you.” It is unclear when the exchange took place. The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office in Louisiana confirmed Ken’s death to Us earlier on Thursday, saying its officers had “responded to a residence” after “receiving a call at 6:15 p.m.” Authorities confirmed Ken “was found dead upon arrival” and added, “At this time, we are continuing the death investigation.”
